review_method: Visual inspection of all 12 samples in a full-frame contact sheet, all four source/output comparison sheets, and selected 1024-square raw PNGs. Automated alpha/dimension/bbox inspection for every raw file.
overall: Costume concept promising; alpha passed; exact pose/registration not passed; full animation production deferred for user review.

registration.native_scale_definition: Output pixels divided by requested 4x reference scale; actual generated pixel grid is not uniformly 4x.
registration.caution: Silhouette measurements are not skeletal joint detection. Hair, tail, ahoge and new accessories affect extents. Raw full-frame comparison visibly confirms scale and position mismatch.

category_findings.idle: Idle 1 has a larger figure than 2/3. Idle 3 invents a hand-near-chin pose. Not a registered breathing loop.
category_findings.walk: Readable walking silhouette, but 2/3 have very similar leg and arm phases; not a complete opposite-step cycle.
category_findings.cast: Readable casting gestures, but 1/2 reinterpret the source hand and arm poses. Third sample follows the source's opposite-facing arm direction.
category_findings.jump: Raised-arm and airborne silhouettes readable; limb angles, torso registration and phase spacing differ from source. Not a timed trajectory.

edge_and_pixel_findings: Local blue/purple edge noise is visible in raw PNGs
Fine shading and pixel clusters vary; a consistent native pixel grid has not been established
recommended_next_step: After user reviews the design, lock one master sprite at native size, define head/hands/pelvis/shoe anchors, and use controlled pose deformation/local redraws with continuous-motion review before expanding production.
